chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Abi Khadija, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Be choosy regarding the shrouds, for you will be resurrected in them.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic recommendation regarding the quality of shrouds for burial?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) encourages believers to 'beautify' (*tanawqoo*) their shrouds, emphasizing that the deceased will be resurrected in the garments they are buried in. This teaching underscores the Shia belief in the physical resurrection (*al-Ba'ath al-Jismani*), linking the dignity of the body in the grave to its state on the Day of Judgment. It reflects the broader Islamic emphasis on honoring the dead and preparing for the afterlife with care and reverence.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Abu Khadeeja, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Be choosy regarding the shrouds for you would be Resurrected in it’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Hashim from abu Khadijah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Try to make your shrouds look beautiful; you will be raised with your shrouds.’”
